source_summary: Chinese landscape with a thatched riverside pavilion, foreground scholars on an arched bridge, layered misty mountains, autumnal trees, and dark-needle pines. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: misty_right_mountain
motifs.description: Isolate the tall distant mountain mass on the upper right: steep layered peak, darker left escarpment, pale washed summit and foothill slopes fading into mist.
must_preserve: ragged silhouette of the upper peak
darker vertical cliff edge on the left side
blurred mist transitions at the lower slopes
subtle internal texture strokes and clouded tonal patches

motifs.name: central_mist_hills
motifs.description: Isolate the pale middle-distance hills and small pointed ridge behind the pavilion, including the low layered silhouettes receding toward the right.
must_preserve: small dark pointed hill near center

motifs.name: left_autumn_tree_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the tall grove at the left of the pavilion: bare trunks, branching limbs, dark leafy clusters, and ochre autumn foliage overlapping the left side of the scene.
must_preserve: pale vertical trunks with dry-brush texture
layered foliage depth around the pavilion side

motifs.name: thatched_pavilion
motifs.description: Isolate the low thatched pavilion or hut in the middle-left: broad straw roof, rectangular wall plane, two barred window/door sections, and raised stone platform.
must_preserve: thin roof outline and slightly sagging eaves
fine straw hatch marks along the roof edge
vertical lattice bars in the two openings
stone base blocks and platform linework

motifs.name: right_pine_group
motifs.description: Isolate the large foreground pine cluster on the right: multiple trunks rising from a rocky base with sweeping branches and dense dark needle clusters.

motifs.name: right_rocky_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the rocky ground and bank beneath and around the right pine trunks, including the root mound, angular stones, and pale sloping earth forms.
must_preserve: tufts of grass at the pine roots
pale earth wash around the stones

motifs.name: foreground_bridge_scholars
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left arched stone bridge with the two small scholar figures standing on the path above it.
must_preserve: individual stone block pattern on the bridge
thin path line continuing across the bridge
muted orange robe accent and pale robe wash
small dark hats and minimal facial/hand linework

motifs.name: right_misty_water_inlet
motifs.description: Isolate the small pale water inlet and low shoreforms in the right middle distance, with tiny dark marks suggesting banks or rocks amid mist.
must_preserve: small dark rock or bank marks

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
